s: Shello liqrot keneged me raglayim ubo b' seipim: me raglayim leachar shennapelu laaretz, kevan sheen issuran ella middibre soperim — yakol lebattelam al yede sheyyishpok alehem rebiit mayim. Vaapillu hem bikli — metil alehem rebiit mayim, ben shehayu hem techilla bakkeli venoten alehem rebiit mayim, ben shennoten techilla hammayim bakkeli. Ubilbad shello yihyeh keli hamyuchad leme raglayim, sheaz apillu en bo me raglayim kelal — asur liqrot kenegdan, veen moil bintinat hammayim lehakshir hakkeli atzmo kemo sheyyitbaer siman p"z:

Rebiit sheameru — leme raglayim shel paam echad ben shehishtin harbeh o meat, uleshel b' peamim — b' rebiit, uleshel g' peamim — g', veken leolam. Vekol zeh keshehem beayin, abal im nibleu bebeged ap al pi shehu topeach al menat lehatpiach, im chozer umatpicho bammayim — dayyo, ubeshabbat menaggeb bo yadayv kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sh"b.
